summary.text: Ryan Bizzarro is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 3 who has served since December 1, 2012 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Bizzarro was elected chairman of the House Democratic Policy Committee for the 2021-22 session.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Bizzarro earned an A.A. in political science and a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Edinboro University and a master's degree in public administration from Gannon University.

His professional experience includes working as an advocate for the Office of District Attorney and Crime Victim Center in Erie County and as a behavioral health specialist for McKinley Elementary School.
He was elected chairman of the House Democratic Policy Committee for the 2021-22 legislative session and served on the Rules Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
